description: Change one of the account's codes: where a website-link code points (destination), a contact card's details (contact, replacing the whole card), its name or folder, or pause and resume a changeable code (status). Only the fields you send change. A new destination or a pause applies to everyone who scans the printed code from then on, so confirm with the person first; both are recorded in the code's history (get_code shows it). A new destination goes through the same link checks as create_code. Codes can't be deleted, and a code locked by a lapsed plan can't be edited (it keeps working). Needs a key that can make and change codes. Returns the code as list_codes shows it, plus which fields changed.

code.description: The code: its id from list_codes, or a changeable code's link ending (e.g. "menu" for makemyqrcodes.com/menu)

contact.description: Contact cards: the full new card (replaces the old one; needs first, last or org)

destination.description: Website-link codes: the new web address

folder.description: Move it to this folder, any name; an empty string takes it out of its folder

name.description: New name shown in the account; an empty string makes one from the content

status.description: paused shows a "paused" page when scanned; active resumes it. Changeable codes only

name: update_code

changed.description: The fields that changed; empty when nothing did

folder.description: Left out when the code isn't in a folder

holds.description: Where it points, or what it holds, in a few words

id.description: Use it as "code" in get_code, update_code and download_code

last_scan_at.description: ISO time of the latest scan

link.description: Changeable codes: the short link the printed code holds

locked.description: true when a lapsed plan locks editing; the code still works

scans.description: Changeable codes: scans of all time, automated checks left out

title: Change a code
